result.summary: The page is generally well laid out. The main visual defect is a nonsensical discount badge showing '–0%' on the pizza restaurant card, which indicates broken promotional data or a formatting bug. A couple of minor consistency issues were also noted.

issues.description: The pizza restaurant card in the 'Popular right now' section displays a '–0%' discount badge. A zero-percent discount is meaningless and suggests a data or formatting bug (e.g., a missing discount value defaulting to 0).
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when the discount value is 0 or missing, and validate promo data before rendering the badge.

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' section, Tokumaru Ramen Bar shows a rating (4.8, 500+) while the pizza card below shows no rating, making card metadata inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Ensure all restaurant cards display consistent metadata (rating, delivery info), or show a placeholder such as 'New' when a rating is unavailable.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' card images have inconsistent visual treatments: the Green Bowl Poké image is on a light gray background while the other cards use dark, moody photo backgrounds, creating uneven visual weight across the row.
issues.suggestion: Standardize image styling (background treatment, brightness, cropping) for cards in the same carousel to maintain visual consistency.
